xml.insert: CREATE TABLE META_APP ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DISPLAY_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, URL CLOB NULL, DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, SUMMARY VARCHAR2(1024) NULL, AUTHOR VARCHAR2(240) NULL, COMPANY VARCHAR2(240) NULL, PRODUCT VARCHAR2(80) NULL, WEIGHT NUMBER(11, 3) NULL, SEQUENCE NUMBER(22, 3) NULL, ICON VARCHAR2(240) NULL, LATEST_VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, APPLICATION CHAR(1) NULL, LICENSE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, META_APP_STORE_ID VARCHAR2(255) NULL, JAR_FILE_ID VARCHAR2(200) NULL, JAR_FILE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, MD5 VARCHAR2(64) NULL, VIEW_FILE_ID VARCHAR2(200) NULL, VIEW_FILE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, STATE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, SOURCE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, LOADER_TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, KIND VARCHAR2(80) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, IS_PRIMARY CHAR(1) NULL, GLOBAL CHAR(1) NULL, REINSTALL CHAR(1) NULL, VIEW_FILE_FRONTEND CLOB NULL, FRONT_TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, FRONT_VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, FRONT_AUTHOR VARCHAR2(240) NULL, CATEGORY_IDS VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_APP_STORE ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DISPLAY_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, LATEST_VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DESCRIPTION CLOB NULL, SUMMARY VARCHAR2(1024) NULL, AUTHOR VARCHAR2(240) NULL, COMPANY VARCHAR2(240) NULL, PRODUCT VARCHAR2(80) NULL, WEIGHT NUMBER(22, 3) NULL, SEQUENCE NUMBER(22, 3) NULL, URL CLOB NULL, ICON VARCHAR2(240) NULL, APPLICATION CHAR(1) NULL, LICENSE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, JAR_FILE_ID VARCHAR2(200) NULL, MD5 VARCHAR2(64) NULL, VIEW_FILE_ID VARCHAR2(200) NULL, SOURCE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, APP_MARKET VARCHAR2(80) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, LOADER_TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, REINSTALL CHAR(1) NULL, GLOBAL CHAR(1) NULL, KIND VARCHAR2(80) NULL, VIEW_FILE_FRONTEND CLOB NULL, FRONT_TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, FRONT_VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, FRONT_AUTHOR VARCHAR2(240) NULL, VIEW_FILE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, CATEGORY_IDS VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_APP_CATEGORY ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_ATTACHMENT ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(512) NULL, "SIZE" NUMBER NULL, MD5 VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CONTENT_TYPE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, BUCKET VARCHAR2(128) NULL, KEY VARCHAR2(128) NULL, DOWNLOAD_URL VARCHAR2(512) NULL, PREVIEW_URL VARCHAR2(512) NULL, MODEL_ID VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DESCRIPTION VARCHAR2(512) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, APP_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )
CREATE TABLE META_APP_DEPENDENCY ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, APP_IDS VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_APP_STORE_DEPENDENCY ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DISPLAY_NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, VERSION VARCHAR2(240) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, META_APP_STORE_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_MODEL_CHANGE ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, META_ID VARCHAR2(240) NULL, JSON CLOB NULL, SOURCE_APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DELETE_FLAG CHAR(1) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_MODEL_CHANGE_LOG ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, META_ID VARCHAR2(240) NULL, JSON CLOB NULL, SOURCE_APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, DELETE_FLAG CHAR(1) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE META_MODEL_DATA ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, MODEL VARCHAR2(240) NULL, APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, BODY CLOB NULL, LAST_SYNC_DATA TIMESTAMP NULL, APP_IDS VARCHAR2(13) NULL, DATA_ID VARCHAR2(240) NULL, SOURCE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE UI_FILE_SEED ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(512) NULL, PATH VARCHAR2(512) NULL, FILE_ARCHIVE_PATH VARCHAR2(512) NULL, DOWNLOAD_PATH VARCHAR2(512) NULL, ATTACHMENT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, URL VARCHAR2(512) NULL, MD5 VARCHAR2(64) NULL, BUCKET VARCHAR2(128) NULL, APP_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, MODEL_ID VARCHAR2(240) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE UI_VIEW_SEED ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, NAME VARCHAR2(240) NULL, MODEL VARCHAR2(240) NULL, KEY VARCHAR2(240) NULL, PRIORITY NUMBER NULL, ACTIVE CHAR(1) NULL, BODY CLOB NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(80) NULL, IS_DELETE CHAR(1) NULL, "MODE" VARCHAR2(80) NULL, INHERIT_IDS VARCHAR2(64) NULL, APP_IDS VARCHAR2(64) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, CREATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL, UPDATE_USER VARCHAR2(64) NULL, UPDATE_DATE TIMESTAMP NULL )

CREATE TABLE CONFIG_CENTER ( ID VARCHAR2(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, APP VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TAG VARCHAR2(240) NULL, TYPE VARCHAR2(240) NULL, KEY VARCHAR2(240) NULL, VALUE VARCHAR2(2000) NULL, "DESC" VARCHAR2(240) NULL, REQUIRED CHAR(1) NULL, TENANT_ID VARCHAR2(64) NULL )
